subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexaamminecobalt(III)（[Co(NH₃)₆]³⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Square pyramidal
D. Tetrahedral
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Co (group 9) 9 e; 6 × NH₃ (L) 12 e; the 3+ charge removes 3 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 3+ charge, so the metal is Co(III), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e.
